posts.cooked:
So, most of the new additional rules for Vengeance boil down to "things that affect a villain only affect one of them."  However, Legacy's card Take Down says "Villain cards cannot be played."

As currently phrased, that shuts down the entire Vengeful Five cycle. Is that the intended interaction, or is it intended to stop just one of them?
